metadata.title: MohandesYar AI 2.0: An Offline-First Persian PWA for Civil Engineering Field Documentation, Evidence Integrity, and Reporting
metadata.description: MohandesYar AI 2.0 is an offline-first Persian progressive web application for civil-engineering field documentation. It stores original image and video evidence locally in IndexedDB, records optional geolocation and SHA-256 integrity metadata, supports verified backup and restore, and generates multi-page Persian A4 reports.
metadata.notes: Technical report MYAI-TR-2026-02. The DOI field must be populated only by Zenodo after public publication.
